ns2:section.sectionText: Online & Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. This section is available only to those students who completed the fall section. Class will meet weekly for on-line discussions Tuesdays between 6:30 - 9:00 p.m. (central time). Participation is absolutely critical. In addition, students are expected to organize times to meet with one another outside of formal class meetings.
